passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: I am a girl, and my name is Mina.
I am thirteen years old, and I am in the sixth grade.
I want to be a kind girl at school and at home.
phrases.ko: 나는 학교와 집에서 친절한 아이가 되고 싶어요.

phrases.en: I smile when I meet my friends.
I like to help my friends when they need me.
I am happy when we play together.
I am not very tall, but I can run fast.
phrases.ko: 나는 키가 아주 크지는 않지만, 빨리 달릴 수 있어요.

phrases.en: I want to be brave when something is hard.
I help my little sister because she is younger than me.
My friends say that I am kind and happy.
I like myself, and I want to grow a little every day.
phrases.ko: 나는 나 자신을 좋아하고, 매일 조금씩 자라고 싶어요.

full_passage_spoken: I am a girl, and my name is Mina. I am thirteen years old, and I am in the sixth grade. I want to be a kind girl at school and at home. I smile when I meet my friends. I like to help my friends when they need me. I am happy when we play together. I am not very tall, but I can run fast. I want to be brave when something is hard. I help my little sister because she is younger than me. My friends say that I am kind and happy. I like myself, and I want to grow a little every day.
